---
title: "QoL death-inclusive Markov — model diagnostics"
subtitle: "Posterior sampling quality across completed datasets"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rmsb)
library(posterior)
library(knitr)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "markov.R"))

n_imputations <- config$imputation$m_supporting
indices <- seq_len(n_imputations)

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "03-quality-of-life", "03-longitudinal-with-death", "results"
)
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
table_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "model-diagnostics")
stan_dx_dir <- file.path(table_dir, "stan-dx")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures", "model-diagnostics")

dir.create(stan_dx_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Parameter diagnostics and `stanDx()` reports

```{r}
#| label: compute-diagnostics
#| include: false

diagnostics <- indices |>
  map(\(index) {
    model <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))
    model_diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, config$diagnostics)

    writeLines(
      capture.output(stanDx(model)),
      file.path(stan_dx_dir, sprintf("stan-dx-%02d.txt", index))
    )
    # Trace plot of every parameter, including the random-intercept SD.
    trace_parameters <- c(colnames(model$draws), colnames(model$omega))
    save_figure(
      plot_traces(trace_draws(model, trace_parameters), ncol = 3),
      file.path(stan_dx_dir, sprintf("stan-dx-%02d.png", index)),
      height = 1.4 * ceiling(length(trace_parameters) / 3)
    )

    as.data.frame(model_diagnostics$summary) |>
      mutate(
        imputation = index,
        divergent_transitions = model_diagnostics$divergent_transitions,
        treedepth_exceeded = model_diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded,
        min_bfmi = model_diagnostics$min_bfmi
      )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

fit_attempts <- indices |>
  map(\(index) {
    read_parquet(
      file.path(model_dir, sprintf("fit-attempts-%02d.parquet", index))
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

final_fit_attempts <- fit_attempts |>
  slice_max(attempt, n = 1L, with_ties = FALSE, by = imputation)

stopifnot(
  "The final fit attempt did not pass for every imputation" =
    setequal(fit_attempts$imputation, indices) &&
      all(final_fit_attempts$diagnostics_passed)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: summarise-diagnostics
#| include: false

finite_min <- function(value) {
  if (any(is.finite(value))) min(value[is.finite(value)]) else NA_real_
}

diagnostic_summary <- diagnostics |>
  summarise(
    max_rhat = if (any(is.finite(rhat))) {
      max(rhat[is.finite(rhat)])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    min_ess_bulk = finite_min(ess_bulk),
    min_ess_tail = finite_min(ess_tail),
    divergent_transitions = first(divergent_transitions),
    treedepth_exceeded = first(treedepth_exceeded),
    min_bfmi = first(min_bfmi),
    .by = imputation
  ) |>
  mutate(
    passed =
      max_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat &
        min_ess_bulk >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk &
        min_ess_tail >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail &
        divergent_transitions <= config$diagnostics$max_divergent_transitions &
        treedepth_exceeded <= config$diagnostics$max_treedepth_exceeded &
        (is.na(min_bfmi) | min_bfmi >= config$diagnostics$min_bfmi)
  )

stopifnot(
  "At least one longitudinal QoL Markov model failed posterior diagnostics" =
    nrow(diagnostic_summary) == n_imputations &&
      all(diagnostic_summary$passed)
)

write_parquet(
  diagnostics,
  file.path(table_dir, "parameter-diagnostics.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  diagnostic_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, "model-diagnostic-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  fit_attempts,
  file.path(table_dir, "fit-attempts.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Worst posterior sampling diagnostic within each fitted imputation"
#| echo: false

diagnostic_summary |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fit-attempts
#| tbl-cap: "Model fit attempts and recorded reasons for refitting"
#| echo: false

fit_attempts |>
  transmute(
    imputation,
    attempt,
    iterations_per_chain,
    retained_draws_per_chain,
    diagnostics_passed,
    reason = refit_reason
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## R-hat and ESS by imputation

```{r}
#| label: fig-posterior-diagnostics
#| fig-cap: "Posterior convergence and effective sample size across imputations"
#| fig-subcap:
#|   - "Parameter-level R-hat distributions; the dashed line is the configured maximum"
#|   - "Parameter-level bulk and tail effective sample sizes; the dashed line is the configured minimum"
#| fig-alt: "Two panels summarize posterior diagnostics for each Markov model. R-hat values remain below the configured threshold and effective sample sizes remain above the configured minimum."
#| layout-ncol: 1
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false

rhat_plot <- diagnostics |>
  filter(is.finite(rhat)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(imputation), y = rhat)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = config$diagnostics$max_rhat,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = reference_line_colour
  ) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey85", colour = "grey45", scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(x = "Imputation", y = "R-hat")

ess_plot <- diagnostics |>
  select(imputation, ess_bulk, ess_tail) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(ess_bulk, ess_tail),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "ess"
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(ess)) |>
  mutate(
    metric = recode(metric, ess_bulk = "Bulk ESS", ess_tail = "Tail ESS")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(imputation), y = ess, fill = metric)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = reference_line_colour
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    outlier.alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.85, end = 0.55) +
  labs(x = "Imputation", y = "Effective sample size", fill = NULL)

save_figure(rhat_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "rhat-by-imputation.png"))
save_figure(ess_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "ess-by-imputation.png"))

rhat_plot
ess_plot
```
